reviews.review:
"EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 5" is a 9 year old Playstation 4 game that was dumped onto PC as nothing but a cash grab as far as I can see... okay, yes, there is a game here, but the developer is charging an insane, full AAA $60 price tag for a game that looks and plays worse than 2004's Half-Life 2. 

But wait, there's more... an eye watering, toxic $85 USD in content and cosmetic paywalled DLC you also have to buy if you want the complete game, bringing the price of this up to a completely insulting ONE HUNDRED AND FOURTY FIVE UNITED STATES DOLLARS.... for a b-grade 2017 Playstation 4 port.  Disgusting, isn't it?

The plot of the game is... well... this is kind of just a copy + paste of EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 4.  Change some levels, reskin some stuff, try get paid for the same game twice.  You're basically like a security/cop dude and you fight aliens.  Yawn.  There's some progression and lightweight RPG mechanisms but these boil down pretty quickly to a pointless feeling, repetitive grind.

The wingsuits and power armors and weapons combinations might seem appealing, but on PC this works out to a kind of clunky and weak third person arcade shooter... it's not the worst but it's very far from the best.

There's a strong multiplayer/co-op focus but not much of a lively population, so matchmaking probably won't get you far, soloing isn't easy, and if you try to convince your friends to play crappy PS4 ports from 2017 on PC, you soon won't have any.  This is largely a dead game.

On technicals... 

On the upside, the game does feature customisable controls and resolution, so at least some of the basic, minimum requirements have been met.  Unfortunately there's a number of other technical defects and shortcomings which contribute to the game being difficult to recommend to gamers.

The console port is pretty bad... it works, but it's clunky as all hell.  For some reason, Playstation ports are always terrible compared to Xbox and even Nintendo Switch ports.  If you play a badly ported console game on PC, the safe bet is to assume it's come from Playstation, and EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 5 is a great example of that. 

Because this is designed for consoles, it carries a number of deliberate design deficiencies.  Compromises were made to cater to the inferior console gaming appliances that the game was designed for.  These are unfortunate compromises and limitations that PC gamers shouldn't be forced to accept, but it's evident that PC was a second thought for the console-centric developers.  The game is deficient as a result of these choices, and would have been so much better without the handicaps that designing games for consoles forces upon a game.  Once more, console peasants have made gaming worse for everyone.

Due to the age of this game, and the lack of modernisation, the graphics appear quite dated.  This compares poorly to more contemporary games with professional standards.  Given that gaming is primarily a visual medium, this is a bit of a problem, so should be taken into account when considering whether to get this game.

These technical defects push this game below acceptable standards for any modern PC game.

Let's talk about price and the value this represents for us gamers.  Should you buy this game?  Is it among the best the Steam catalogue has to offer?

EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 5 has the gamer gouging price of $60 USD ($145 for the full game), for which you could easily get several brand new AAA games!

The quality problems and defects with this game makes the asking price totally unrealistic. It's impossible to recommend this to gamers here on Steam, especially considering the unethical pricing.  Honestly if this was a $5 game, it might even be worth it, but for $145 I have a long list of suggestions for the developers which I can't relate here due to Steam community guidelines about profanity and anatomical feasibility.
disgusting little frogs get beamed by my beam of destruction

Earth Defense Force 5 is one of the greatest values one can get for $60. It is massive, replayable, strategic, fun, varied, and dedicated to upholding a firm foundation of quality in a long running series built atop being under budgeted. I love this game, I love Air Raider, I love blowing up giant bugs, I love the equipment system. If the price seems too scary, get it on sale and don't regret it!
